description: This PHP source file defines the TemplateAddress class, which extends TemplateField, used within the SuiteCRM system for handling address-related fields in dynamic forms. It includes methods for saving address data and manages external dependencies related to field templates and label parsing.

classes.name: TemplateAddress
classes.description: A class representing address fields in dynamic form templates, providing functionality to save address components and handle related labels.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the address data, updates labels, and creates sub-fields for city, state, postal code, and country.
